title: Lucky Wheel
description: A wheel system with customizable slots, block types, rotation direction, animation speed, detailed tickets, nine weighted prizes with holograms and command rewards, plus full hex-color support for all messages.
body:
# Lucky Wheel – Feature Overview & Commands

A powerful, customizable wheel system featuring editable slots, block types, spin direction, animation speed, slowdown effects, custom tickets, and nine weighted rewards with holograms and command-based prizes. All messages support hex colors for smooth styling.
Commands:
/lw create <name> – Auto-spawn a new wheel at your location
/lw link <name> – Link existing vertical blocks (left-click blocks, right-click to finish)
/lw delete <name> – Remove a wheel
/lw spin <wheel> – Spin a wheel using a ticket
/lw giveticket <player> <amount> – Give tickets to players
/lw reload – Reload configuration
